 From Bhutan to Sri Lanka — Passing the Baton towards Zero by 30
 18 November 2026 11:00 – 12:30 IST 
 Venue: Virtual ( via Zoom), 
 Reading time: 
 Join United Against Rabies for a regional event marking the transition from Bhutan’s rabies elimination achievements to Sri Lanka’s journey towards Zero by 30. 
 The programme will highlight regional progress towards eliminating dog-mediated human rabies, lessons from Bhutan’s elimination journey, Sri Lanka’s roadmap to elimination, and experiences from the Pan American Health Organization (PAHO). A moderated discussion will explore sustained financing, dog population management, cross-border risks, community engagement and maintaining elimination.
 Please register to receive your Zoom joining details. The meeting will be held in a hybrid format, with an in-person component in Colombo.
